how_to_update: Hand-kept. Each Tuesday, before the build, add the coming week's quarterback news that the nflverse rosters and injury reports cannot show yet: trades, signings, benchings and starters named by the team or reported by a named reporter. One entry per team under the week number: 'starter' (the name as nflverse spells it), 'conf' ('named' = the team or a reporter says he is the starter; 'expected' = the coach or a reporter says he is expected or could start), 'sources' (who, what, when in UTC), and 'unavailable' (quarterbacks in the team's season figures who will not play for it, with why). Never add a starter without a source. The injury report still decides game statuses; this file only covers what it cannot.
